US Teen Arrested for Alleged Hindu Temple Mass Shooting Plot

Authorities in Aurora, Illinois, arrested a 19-year-old, identified as Alexandros Paporakis, for allegedly plotting a mass shooting at a Hindu temple. The plot was reportedly foiled after Paporakis told a coworker that Sunday would be "a special day." A manifesto attributed to the suspect, described as a white supremacist, was recovered. The motive for targeting Hindus in the US is being questioned.
